entries.title: A card on your phone stays after you look at another tab
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad, a card could be replaced by "This card stopped responding" after you visited Activity or Tasks, or while a busy device was still opening it. Infinitary now waits only on a card you can see, and a slow answer counts as an answer. A card that really stops answering still offers Retry.
entries.noPicture: The fix removes a wrong message; the card itself looks as it did before.
